geometry_edits.rationale: Strengthen the dominant continuous gesture so the mass reads as one coherent bent body rather than a box with a slight warp.
Increase curvature to clarify hierarchy and reduce the generic extrusion reading.
Keep the bend aligned to the existing longitudinal logic; only intensify the executable path.
Add subdivision so the bend compiles into a smoother continuous section and better preserves the silhouette across views.
Bring the cantilever lower/earlier to create a stronger public undercut and improve ground-level response to the access edge.
Shift the overhang toward the frontage so the void reads as an intentional entry seam, not a generic setback.
Preserve the frontage-aligned opening on the access side.
Widen the opening so the void becomes legible as usable public space.

rationale: The candidate is coherent enough in plan/isometric, with a dominant bent mass and a recognizable public threshold device, but the four views reveal a compact stepped block that is too generic and too sealed for the neighborhood-living brief. The blue road edge is read, yet the response to it is weak: the notch/cantilever create only a shallow seam rather than a clearly public court or entry void aligned to the access side. The silhouette is legible but reads as stacked massing more than a capacity-aware active-ground building; section logic does not convincingly express a neighborhood public threshold or inhabited void. It also appears visually consistent across views, so it passes repair integrity, but fails the stronger program-fit gate because the visible ground relation and public-space figure are underdeveloped for the required active edge and mixed-use threshold.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise composed massing with a large carved central void and a clear bridge/connector gesture that keeps the ground plane legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference leans more retail/hospitality and is more open/transparent than the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Horizontal spread, courtyard void, and a roof that reads as a continuous environmental section rather than a box.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Educational/civic reading is stronger than mixed neighborhood living; avoid excessive scenic choreography.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Still more institutional/cultural than residential-neighborhood program; the candidate is much more compact.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking low-rise volumes around a central void with voids under elevated portions, preserving a strong ground threshold.

warnings: Parcel containment could not be fully verified from the provided view data alone; this assessment assumes the visible green boundary is the actual parcel.
The access edge is present but the mass does not strongly open toward it; the response is semantically weaker than the brief requires.
The form’s continuity is acceptable, but its section is still too generic and box-led for neighborhood-living with an active public ground condition.
